summary: zap.c:makewish omits the unsafe-corpse wish branch for a cockatrice corpse while the hero is a flesh golem. C marks the corpse wishedfor, materializes it on the floor, and prints the careful warning; JavaScript follows the ordinary wish drop path, producing the first mismatch at step 54. The later eatcorpse RNG mismatch follows this placement divergence.

source.branch: At zap.c:6401-6420, if the wished object is a CORPSE and u_safe_from_fatal_corpse(otmp, st_all) is false, C sets otmp->wishedfor. On the ordinary floor this selects the verb "materialize" and the "Careful! %s on the floor!" message before hold_another_object. The assigned recording reaches this branch by using Ctrl-W to wish for a cockatrice corpse after #polyself has changed the hero to a flesh golem.
callers: wizcmds.c:wiz_wish() calls makewish() at line 38; the assigned recording reaches #wizwish through Ctrl-W.

evidence: The saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261007010702-v25.json at 9aea0fdd726850fad5342bc3eabb32f89a78a0c0 reports the first screen mismatch at segment 0, step 54, row 0 column 0 (C cell "C", JavaScript cell "o"); its first RNG mismatch is later, at step 56 in eatcorpse(). The v25 manifest records the C observation as "Careful! The cockatrice corpse materializes on the floor!".

The checked-out C source is the evaluation commit’s nethack-c/upstream gitlink 16ff59115315917b93185d026aeefea06db9b0f4. In src/zap.c:6401-6420, makewish() sets wishedfor for a corpse that u_safe_from_fatal_corpse(otmp, st_all) considers unsafe, then chooses materialize and the careful floor message before calling hold_another_object(). The recipe’s Ctrl-W wish after #polyself reaches this caller path through wizcmds.c:wiz_wish().

In js/zap.js:1954-1970 at the evaluated commit, makewish() selects only slip/drop and ordinary Oops messages; it omits the unsafe-corpse predicate and wishedfor update. The existing JavaScript helpers are js/pickup.js:u_safe_from_fatal_corpse() and js/invent.js:hold_another_object(), so no missing helper blocks the source correction. The single-session diagnostic replay (node scripts/scan-sessions.mjs --json --synthetic v25/v25-flesh-golem-eats-cockatrice; bounded run-KBNHkb) reproduced the step-54 mismatch. It also noted artifact.c:retouch_equipment and trap.c:selftouch during the earlier polymorph setup; those precede the mismatch and do not block attribution to makewish().
